headline: Big Tech Issuing More Shares
detail: This headline directly impacts your tech-heavy portfolio. If major tech companies like Meta and Alphabet issue more shares, it can dilute existing ownership and put downward pressure on stock prices.
rec: Given your concentration and margin use, consider trimming positions in highly leveraged tech ETFs like METU if this trend accelerates.

headline: Treasury Yield Slides
detail: The slide in the 10-year Treasury yield suggests a shift in market sentiment, potentially towards safer assets. This can sometimes put pressure on growth-oriented tech stocks.
rec: Monitor how this impacts your broader tech holdings, especially the leveraged ones like SOXL and PLTU.

headline: Healthcare Sector Moves
detail: News about CVS splitting off its drugstore business and hospital stocks rallying while drugmakers brace for scrutiny indicates sector-specific shifts within healthcare. This is less directly relevant to your tech/chip focus.
rec: This headline does not directly warrant a change in your current tech-focused holdings.
